# Defs: changing and writing

`game.defs` reads, changes and writes game definitions. The kit is Advanced in the [stability tiers](stability.md).

Runtime changes (`set`) edit the loaded def, record what the value was, and can be undone with `restore`. They last until the game restarts. Use them for balance mods and for tweaks that depend on settings.

```lua
game.defs.set("ThingDef", "Steel", "stackLimit", 1000)
game.defs.set("ThingDef", "Steel", "statBases[0].value", 2)   -- nested fields and list items
print(game.defs.value("ThingDef", "Steel", "stackLimit"))     -- 1000
game.defs.restore("ThingDef", "Steel", "stackLimit")
for _, c in ipairs(game.defs.changes()) do print(c.kind, c.def, c.path) end
```

`of` and `of_mod` answer which mod a def comes from, so a patch mod can check before it changes something.

Authoring turns a Lua table into Def XML, checked against the game's own types (fields, values, enums and def references), and writes it to the mod's `Defs` folder. The game loads it at the next start.

```lua
local xml = game.defs.to_xml("ThingDef", "MyMeal", {
  label = "my meal", stackLimit = 20,
  statBases = { MaxHitPoints = 50 },
  comps = { { _class = "CompProperties_Forbiddable" } },
}, { parent = "ResourceBase" })

local check = game.defs.validate_xml(xml)
if not check.ok then for _, e in ipairs(check.errors) do print(e) end end

game.defs.write_xml("my.mod.id", "ThingDef", "MyMeal", { label = "my meal", stackLimit = 20 })
```

Custom data tables are defs of type `RimKit.LuaDataDef`. Rows carry a table name, a dictionary of values and a list, and `game.defs.data_rows("table")` reads them:

```xml
<RimKit.LuaDataDef>
  <defName>Row1</defName>
  <table>my_table</table>
  <values><li><key>speed</key><value>3</value></li></values>
  <list><li>a</li></list>
</RimKit.LuaDataDef>
```

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.defs.set` | `kind, def, path, value` | `string` | Changes one field of a def, by path such as stackLimit, plant.growDays or statBases[0].value. The change is recorded. Returns the new value. |
| `game.defs.value` | `kind, def, path` | `any` | Reads a field of a def. |
| `game.defs.fields` | `kind` | `RimDefField[]` | The fields of a def type. |
| `game.defs.kinds` |  | `string[]` | Every def type name. |
| `game.defs.restore` | `kind?, def?, path?` | `integer` | Puts back recorded changes, newest first. Returns how many. |
| `game.defs.changes` |  | `RimDefChange[]` | Every recorded def change. |
| `game.defs.of` | `kind, def, package_id?` | `RimDefInfo` | A def and the mod it comes from, even from another mod. exists is false when it is not loaded. |
| `game.defs.of_mod` | `package_id, kind` | `RimDefInfo[]` | The defs of one type that a mod defines. |
| `game.defs.data_rows` | `table` | `RimDataRow[]` | The rows of a custom data def table, defined in XML as RimKit.LuaDataDef. |
| `game.defs.to_xml` | `kind, def, fields, opts?` | `string` | Def XML for a table. A key _class sets the Class attribute, lists become li items. |
| `game.defs.validate_xml` | `xml` | `RimXmlCheck` | Checks Def XML against the game's own types: fields, values, enums and def references. |
| `game.defs.write_xml` | `package_id, kind, def, fields, opts?` | `string` | Validates a def and writes it to the mod's Defs folder, loaded at the next start. Returns the file path. |
| `game.defs.write_hediff` | `package_id, defName, label?, initialSeverity?` | `string` | Writes a simple hediff def XML into the mod's Defs folder. Returns the file path. |
| `game.defs.write_recipe` | `package_id, defName, label?, product?, count?` | `string` | Writes a simple recipe def XML into the mod's Defs folder. Returns the file path. |
| `game.defs.mod_root` | `package_id` | `string` | The root folder of a loaded mod. |
